raw_text:
Budget tracking demo MVP: ASP.NET Core 10 minimal API/EF Core (`src/BudgetTracker.Api/`, `Program.cs`, `Auth/`, `AntiForgery/`); React 18/TypeScript strict/Vite/Tailwind/Axios/React Router v7 (`src/BudgetTracker.Web/`); Docker Compose. Prefer simple, readable and composable code. Prefer clear names over generic names like Repository, Service, Manager, etc. Avoid using comments to overexplain everything. No code comments - use descriptive method/class names instead.

Features: Identity cookies + Static API keys (`StaticApiKeysConfiguration`), conditional anti-forgery, database-query-level user isolation, CSV bank-format detection, Azure OpenAI insights/recommendations, pgvector semantic search, background recommendations, natural-language query assistance.

Tests: Microsoft Testing Platform (not VSTest); snake_case `Should_do_when_something`; Testcontainers; NSubstitute preferred. .NET 10 nullable references. PostgreSQL: `Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=budgettracker;Username=budgetuser;Password=budgetpass123`. API http://localhost:5295; frontend http://localhost:5173; Swagger http://localhost:5295/swagger; local CORS.

dotnet watch run
dotnet run -p tests/BudgetTracker.Api.Tests --output detailed --filter-query "/path/to/test"
dotnet ef migrations add MigrationName
dotnet ef database update
npm run dev
npm run build
npm run lint
docker compose up -d
docker compose down

When one of the applications is started for testing, make sure it's stopped once finished.
